messages:
sam: quick async sync after the postmortem on the kv OOM earlier today. goal: list minimal, measurable remediation steps + owners so SRE can validate canary results.

rina: thanks. i've got the heap-diff and allocation hotspots from the run. looks like a steady increase in retained tiny objects from the stream_mapper worker. link: https://redwood/s/INC-2115/heapdiff.html

gabe: i can take a stab at an allocation-budgeting metric and an admission controller for the cache. rough sketch: track per-worker short-lived alloc rate and start shedding when moving-average > X.

chris: SRE note: when you canaries, please include error budget gate and p99 cpu/latency gates. i'll add a temporary dashboard and a playbook snippet.

sam: ACTION ITEMS (compact):
- A1 Profiling + delta heap (owner: rina) \u2014 produce pprof + heapdiff for staging and prod-replay, attach to INC-2115. due: 2026-03-25
- A2 Allocation accounting + metric (owner: gabe) \u2014 implement `kv.alloc.rate` and `kv.alloc.window_1m`. add to Prometheus. due: 2026-03-27
- A3 Admission + soft-evict (owner: gabe) \u2014 soft-evict policy that targets short-lived entries; config toggle. PR: https://redwood/pull/INF-3499. due: 2026-03-29
- A4 Background compactor task (owner: chris) \u2014 run opportunistic compaction every 6h, expose `kv.compaction_runs`. due: 2026-03-28
- A5 Canary + SRE gate (owner: sam) \u2014 canary at 3% with auto-rollback on error_rate>0.7% or kv_fragmentation>0.75. due: 2026-03-26
- A6 Retro + recurring pattern ticket (owner: sam) \u2014 create recurring weekly review INF-3510. due: 2026-04-01

rina: profiling commands i used:```GODEBUG=cgocheck=0 GOMAXPROCS=4 ./server --run-workload=staging-replay
pprof -http=:8081 server.prof
```

gabe: allocation metric proposal snippet:```prometheus.yml
- name: kv_alloc_rate
  expr: rate(kv_alloc_bytes_total[1m])
```

chris: PR for compactor task ready in draft: https://redwood/pull/INF-3501-draft \u2014 it's opt-in and gated by `kv.compactor.enabled`

infra-bot: notice: canary policy updated by @sam at 1864012500 \u2014 route 3% | rollback_on: error_rate>0.7% | kv_fragmentation>0.75

sam: Gabe, can you add a brief README in the PR describing how to validate the admission behavior during the canary? keeps oncall friction low.

gabe: yes. i'll add validation steps and expected graphs (alloc rate, evict count, miss rate). done.

rina: uploaded heap diffs and flamegraphs: https://redwood/s/INC-2115/artifacts/heapdiffs.zip \u2014 initial note: 40% of retained bytes attributed to `stream_mapper.processChunk` call path.

chris: oncall will watch the `kv_evictions` and `kv_compaction_runs` metrics. i'll add alert runbook: if evictions spike > 200/s and p99 latency +80ms, rollback.

gabe: starting admission canary now: `deploy --tag canary-kv-admit --route=3% --sha=8c9d4e`

infra-bot: deploy started: canary-kv-admit by @gabe at 1864012605  route 3% | sha: 8c9d4e

sam: noted. SRE: please confirm when you see stable metrics for 15m and give thumbs to increase route.

chris: watching. added a 15m watch window to the playbook.

infra-bot: alert: kv_fragmentation_ratio hit 0.76 on prod-2 at 1864012725 \u2014 paging SRE.

sam: thanks. halting traffic expansion until SRE confirms stable. rolling canary back to 0% for safety.

gabe: rolling back via `deploy --tag canary-kv-admit --route=0%`

infra-bot: deploy updated: canary-kv-admit route 0% at 1864012750 by @gabe

sam: closing async loop for now. will capture timeline and update INF-3510 with action owners. if the compactor PR lands and the admission control looks good, we can try a constrained re-canary next week.

rina: i'll add a short blurb in INC-2115 about the stream_mapper hotspot and link a mitigation proposal (batching + object reuse).

chris: i'll coordinate a 30m follow-up with SRE + runtime next Mon to review canary telemetry and decide next steps. added to calendar.

gabe: thanks everyone, will continue on PR and metrics.

sam: thanks all.
